passages.text: Now Elisha the prophet summoned one of the sons of the prophets and said to him, “Tuck your cloak under your belt, take this flask of oil, and go to Ramoth-gilead.
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet in Israel.
Elisha called for one of the sons of the prophets.
Elisha spoke to him.
Elisha said, “Prepare yourself for a journey.
Tie your cloak around your waist.
Take this flask of oil in your hand.
Go to Ramoth-gilead.”
passages.original: וֶאֱלִישָׁע֙ הַנָּבִ֔יא קָרָ֕א לְאַחַ֖ד מִבְּנֵ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֑ים וַיֹּ֨אמֶר ל֜וֹ חֲגֹ֣ר מָתְנֶ֗יךָ וְ֠קַח פַּ֣ךְ הַשֶּׁ֤מֶן הַזֶּה֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ וְלֵ֖ךְ רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָֽד׃

passages.text: When you arrive, look for Jehu son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi. Go in, get him away from his companions, and take him to an inner room.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the son of Jehoshaphat.
Jehoshaphat was the son of Nimshi.
Jehu was among his companions.
You must go to the place where Jehu is.
You must look for Jehu.
You must separate Jehu from his companions.
You must take Jehu into an inner room.
passages.original: וּבָ֖אתָ שָׁ֑מָּה וּרְאֵֽה־ שָׁ֠ם יֵה֨וּא בֶן־ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֜ט בֶּן־ נִמְשִׁ֗י וּבָ֙אתָ֙ וַהֲקֵֽמֹתוֹ֙ מִתּ֣וֹך אֶחָ֔יו וְהֵבֵיאתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ חֶ֥דֶר בְּחָֽדֶר׃

passages.text: Then take the flask of oil, pour it on his head, and declare, ‘This is what the LORD says: I anoint you king over Israel.’ Then open the door and run. Do not delay!”
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet of God.
He spoke to one of the sons of the prophets.
He gave him clear instructions.
Take the flask of oil in your hand.
Pour the oil on Jehu’s head.
Say these words: “This is what the LORD says.”
Say, “I anoint you king over Israel.”
After you say this, open the door.
Leave quickly.
Do not wait.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ פַךְ־ הַשֶּׁ֙מֶן֙ וְיָצַקְתָּ֣ עַל־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁחְתִּ֥יךָֽ לְמֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּפָתַחְתָּ֥ הַדֶּ֛לֶת וְנַ֖סְתָּה וְלֹ֥א תְחַכֶּֽה׃

passages.text: So the young prophet went to Ramoth-gilead, and when he arrived, the army commanders were sitting there. “I have a message for you, commander,” he said. “For which of us?” asked Jehu. “For you, commander,” he replied.
passages.sermon:
A young prophet went to Ramoth-gilead.
He arrived there.
The army commanders were sitting together.
The young prophet spoke.
He said, “I have a message for you, commander.”
Jehu asked, “Which one of us?”
The young prophet answered, “For you, commander.”
passages.original: וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ הַנַּ֛עַר הַנַּ֥עַר הַנָּבִ֖יא רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָֽד׃ וַיָּבֹ֗א וְהִנֵּ֨ה שָׂרֵ֤י הַחַ֙יִל֙ יֹֽשְׁבִ֔ים וַיֹּ֕אמֶר דָּבָ֥ר לִ֛י אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַשָּׂ֑ר וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יֵהוּא֙ אֶל־ מִ֣י מִכֻּלָּ֔נוּ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלֶ֥יךָ הַשָּֽׂר׃

passages.text: So Jehu got up and went into the house, where the young prophet poured the oil on his head and declared, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anoint you king over the LORD’s people Israel.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander in Israel’s army.
A young prophet came to Jehu.
Jehu got up.
Jehu went into the house.
The young prophet followed Jehu.
The young prophet carried a flask of oil.
The young prophet poured the oil on Jehu’s head.
The young prophet spoke to Jehu.
The young prophet said, “This is what the LORD says.”
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said, “I anoint you king.”
The LORD said, “You will be king over the LORD’s people.”
The LORD’s people are Israel.
passages.original: וַיָּ֙קָם֙ וַיָּבֹ֣א הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַיִּצֹ֥ק הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן אֶל־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מְשַׁחְתִּ֧יךָֽ לְמֶ֛לֶךְ אֶל־ עַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And you are to strike down the house of your master Ahab, so that I may avenge the blood of My servants the prophets and the blood of all the servants of the LORD shed by the hand of Jezebel.
passages.sermon:
God spoke through the young prophet.
God gave Jehu a command.
Jehu must attack the family of Ahab, his master.
God wants Jehu to destroy Ahab’s house.
God will punish Ahab’s house for killing God’s servants.
God’s servants include the prophets.
Jezebel killed these prophets and other servants of the LORD.
God will avenge their blood through Jehu’s actions.
passages.original: וְהִ֨כִּיתָ֔ה אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית אַחְאָ֖ב אֲדֹנֶ֑יךָ וְנִקַּמְתִּ֞י דְּמֵ֣י׀ עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֗ים וּדְמֵ֛י כָּל־ עַבְדֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מִיַּ֥ד אִיזָֽבֶל׃

passages.text: The whole house of Ahab will perish, and I will cut off from Ahab every male, both slave and free, in Israel.
passages.sermon:
God spoke through the prophet.
God said He would destroy the whole house of Ahab.
God said every male from Ahab’s family would die.
God said He would remove both slave and free men from Ahab’s house in Israel.
passages.original: וְאָבַ֖ד כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י לְאַחְאָב֙ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּקִ֔יר וְעָצ֥וּר וְעָז֖וּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: I will make the house of Ahab like the houses of Jeroboam son of Nebat and Baasha son of Ahijah.
passages.sermon:
God spoke about the house of Ahab.
God said He will punish the house of Ahab.
God will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
God will also make the house of Ahab like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah.
God destroyed the houses of Jeroboam and Baasha because of their sins.
God will bring the same destruction to the house of Ahab.
passages.original: וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֔ב כְּבֵ֖ית יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֑ט וּכְבֵ֖ית בַּעְשָׁ֥א בֶן־ אֲחִיָּֽה׃

passages.text: And on the plot of ground at Jezreel the dogs will devour Jezebel, and there will be no one to bury her.’ ” Then the young prophet opened the door and ran.
passages.sermon:
Jezebel was the queen and wife of Ahab.
God said what would happen to Jezebel.
Dogs will eat Jezebel on the land at Jezreel.
No one will bury her.
The young prophet opened the door.
He ran away.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ אִיזֶ֜בֶל יֹאכְל֧וּ הַכְּלָבִ֛ים בְּחֵ֥לֶק יִזְרְעֶ֖אל וְאֵ֣ין קֹבֵ֑ר וַיִּפְתַּ֥ח הַדֶּ֖לֶת וַיָּנֹֽס׃

passages.text: When Jehu went out to the servants of his master, they asked, “Is everything all right? Why did this madman come to you?” “You know his kind and their babble,” he replied.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander in Israel.
Jehu went out to the servants of his master.
The servants saw Jehu.
They spoke to Jehu.
They asked, “Is everything all right?”
They also asked, “Why did this madman come to you?”
Jehu answered them.
He said, “You know this man.”
He said, “You know how he talks.”
passages.original: וְיֵה֗וּא יָצָא֙ אֶל־ עַבְדֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֔יו וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ הֲשָׁל֔וֹם מַדּ֛וּעַ בָּֽא־ הַמְשֻׁגָּ֥ע הַזֶּ֖ה אֵלֶ֑יךָ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֛ם יְדַעְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ הָאִ֖ישׁ וְאֶת־ שִׂיחֽוֹ׃

passages.text: “That is a lie!” they said. “Tell us now!” So Jehu answered, “He talked to me about this and that, and he said, ‘This is what the LORD says: I anoint you king over Israel.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander in Israel’s army.
Jehu’s fellow officers spoke to him.
They said, “That is a lie!”
They said, “Tell us now!”
Jehu answered them.
He said, “He talked to me about this and that.”
He said, “He told me, ‘This is what the LORD says.’”
He said, “‘I anoint you king over Israel.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ שֶׁ֔קֶר הַגֶּד־ נָ֖א לָ֑נוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כָּזֹ֤את וְכָזֹאת֙ אָמַ֤ר אֵלַי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁחְתִּ֥יךָֽ לְמֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Quickly, each man took his garment and put it under Jehu on the bare steps. Then they blew the ram’s horn and proclaimed, “Jehu is king!”
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander in Israel’s army.
Jehu’s fellow officers heard that God had chosen Jehu to be king.
The officers acted quickly.
Each man took his own garment.
Each man placed his garment under Jehu.
They put the garments on the bare steps.
The officers blew the ram’s horn.
They announced, “Jehu is king!”
passages.original: וַֽיְמַהֲר֗וּ וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ בִּגְד֔וֹ וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ תַחְתָּ֖יו אֶל־ גֶּ֣רֶם הַֽמַּעֲל֑וֹת וַֽיִּתְקְעוּ֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ מָלַ֥ךְ יֵהֽוּא׃

passages.text: Thus Jehu son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi, conspired against Joram. (Now Joram and all Israel had been defending Ramoth-gilead against Hazael king of Aram, but King Joram had returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds he had suffered at the hands of the Arameans in the battle against Hazael their king.) So Jehu said, “If you commanders wish to make me king, then do not let anyone escape from the city to go and tell it in Jezreel.”
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the son of Jehoshaphat.
Jehoshaphat was the son of Nimshi.
Jehu conspired against King Joram.
Joram was the king of Israel.
Joram and all Israel had defended Ramoth-gilead.
They fought against Hazael, king of Aram.
Joram had been wounded by the Arameans in battle.
Joram returned to Jezreel to recover from his wounds.
Jehu spoke to the commanders.
Jehu said, “If you want me to be king, do not let anyone escape from the city.
No one should go to Jezreel to tell what has happened.”
passages.original: וַיִּתְקַשֵּׁ֗ר יֵה֛וּא בֶּן־ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־ נִמְשִׁ֖י אֶל־ יוֹרָ֑ם וְיוֹרָם֩ הָיָ֨ה שֹׁמֵ֜ר בְּרָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֗ד ה֚וּא וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִפְּנֵ֥י חֲזָאֵ֖ל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָֽם׃ וַיָּשָׁב֩ יְהוֹרָ֨ם הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לְהִתְרַפֵּ֣א בִיְזְרְעֶ֗אל מִן־ הַמַּכִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַכֻּ֣הוּ אֲרַמִּ֔ים בְּהִלָּ֣חֲמ֔וֹ אֶת־ חֲזָאֵ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יֵהוּא֙ אִם־ יֵ֣שׁ נַפְשְׁכֶ֔ם אַל־ יֵצֵ֤א פָלִיט֙ מִן־ הָעִ֔יר לָלֶ֖כֶת לַגִּיד בְּיִזְרְעֶֽאל׃

passages.text: Then Jehu got into his chariot and went to Jezreel, because Joram was laid up there and Ahaziah king of Judah had gone down to see him.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander in Israel.
Jehu got into his chariot.
Jehu traveled to Jezreel.
Joram was in Jezreel.
Joram was lying there because he was wounded.
Ahaziah was the king of Judah.
Ahaziah went down to Jezreel.
Ahaziah went to see Joram.
passages.original: וַיִּרְכַּ֤ב יֵהוּא֙ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ יִזְרְעֶ֔אלָה כִּ֥י יוֹרָ֖ם שֹׁכֵ֣ב שָׁ֑מָּה וַֽאֲחַזְיָה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה יָרַ֖ד לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־ יוֹרָֽם׃

passages.text: Now the watchman standing on the tower in Jezreel saw Jehu’s troops approaching, and he called out, “I see a company of troops!” “Choose a rider,” Joram commanded. “Send him out to meet them and ask, ‘Have you come in peace?’ ”
passages.sermon:
A watchman stood on the tower in Jezreel.
He saw Jehu’s troops coming.
He said, “I see a group of men.”
Joram was the king.
Joram said, “Take a horseman.”
Joram said, “Send him to meet them.”
Joram said, “Ask them, ‘Do you come in peace?’”
passages.original: וְהַצֹּפֶה֩ עֹמֵ֨ד עַֽל־ הַמִּגְדָּ֜ל בְּיִזְרְעֶ֗אל וַיַּ֞רְא אֶת־ שִׁפְעַ֤ת יֵהוּא֙ בְּבֹא֔וֹ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁפְעַ֖ת אֲנִ֣י רֹאֶ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹרָ֗ם קַ֥ח רַכָּ֛ב וּֽשְׁלַ֥ח לִקְרָאתָ֖ם וְיֹאמַ֥ר הֲשָׁלֽוֹם׃

passages.text: So a horseman rode off to meet Jehu and said, “This is what the king asks: ‘Have you come in peace?’ ” “What do you know about peace?” Jehu replied. “Fall in behind me.” And the watchman reported, “The messenger reached them, but he is not coming back.”
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander in Israel.
Jehu was approaching Jezreel.
Joram was the king of Israel.
Joram sent a horseman to meet Jehu.
The horseman rode out to Jehu.
The horseman said, “The king asks, ‘Have you come in peace?’”
Jehu answered the horseman.
Jehu said, “What do you know about peace?”
Jehu commanded, “Fall in behind me.”
A watchman stood on the tower in Jezreel.
The watchman saw the messenger reach Jehu.
The watchman reported, “The messenger reached them, but he is not coming back.”
passages.original: וַיֵּלֶךְ֩ רֹכֵ֨ב הַסּ֜וּס לִקְרָאת֗וֹ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הֲשָׁל֔וֹם וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יֵה֛וּא מַה־ לְּךָ֥ וּלְשָׁל֖וֹם סֹ֣ב אֶֽל־ אַחֲרָ֑י וַיַּגֵּ֤ד הַצֹּפֶה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בָּֽא־ הַמַּלְאָ֥ךְ עַד־ הֵ֖ם וְלֹֽא־ שָֽׁב׃

passages.text: So the king sent out a second horseman, who went to them and said, “This is what the king asks: ‘Have you come in peace?’ ” “What do you know about peace?” Jehu replied. “Fall in behind me.”
passages.sermon:
Joram was the king of Israel.
Jehu was the commander of the army.
Joram sent a second horseman to meet Jehu and his men.
The horseman rode up to Jehu and his men.
The horseman said, “The king asks, ‘Have you come in peace?’”
Jehu answered the horseman.
Jehu said, “What do you know about peace?”
Jehu told the horseman, “Get behind me.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח רֹכֵ֣ב סוּס֮ שֵׁנִי֒ וַיָּבֹ֣א אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וַיֹּ֛אמֶר כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֥ר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ שָׁל֑וֹם וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יֵה֛וּא מַה־ לְּךָ֥ וּלְשָׁל֖וֹם סֹ֥ב אֶֽל־ אַחֲרָֽי׃

passages.text: Again the watchman reported, “He reached them, but he is not coming back. And the charioteer is driving like Jehu son of Nimshi —he is driving like a madman!”
passages.sermon:
The watchman saw what happened.
He gave a report.
He said, “The messenger reached Jehu and the others.
But the messenger is not returning.
The man driving the chariot is Jehu son of Nimshi.
He drives his chariot wildly, like a madman.”
passages.original: וַיַּגֵּ֤ד הַצֹּפֶה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בָּ֥א עַד־ אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹֽא־ שָׁ֑ב וְהַמִּנְהָ֗ג כְּמִנְהַג֙ יֵה֣וּא בֶן־ נִמְשִׁ֔י כִּ֥י בְשִׁגָּע֖וֹן יִנְהָֽג׃

passages.text: “Harness!” Joram shouted, and they harnessed his chariot. Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah set out, each in his own chariot, and met Jehu on the property of Naboth the Jezreelite.
passages.sermon:
Joram was the king of Israel.
Ahaziah was the king of Judah.
Joram gave a command.
He said, “Harness!”
The people harnessed Joram’s chariot.
Joram set out in his chariot.
Ahaziah also set out in his own chariot.
Joram and Ahaziah went together.
They went to meet Jehu.
They met Jehu on the property of Naboth the Jezreelite.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹרָם֙ אֱסֹ֔ר וַיֶּאְסֹ֖ר רִכְבּ֑וֹ וַיֵּצֵ֣א יְהוֹרָ֣ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל וַאֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֜ה אִ֣ישׁ בְּרִכְבּ֗וֹ וַיֵּֽצְאוּ֙ לִקְרַ֣את יֵה֔וּא וַיִּמְצָאֻ֔הוּ בְּחֶלְקַ֖ת נָב֥וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִֽי׃

passages.text: When Joram saw Jehu, he asked, “Have you come in peace, Jehu?” “How can there be peace,” he replied, “as long as the idolatry and witchcraft of your mother Jezebel abound?”
passages.sermon:
Joram was the king of Israel.
Jehu was the son of Nimshi.
Joram saw Jehu.
Joram spoke to Jehu.
Joram asked, “Have you come in peace, Jehu?”
Jehu answered Joram.
Jehu said, “There cannot be peace.”
Jehu explained why there could not be peace.
Jehu said, “Your mother is Jezebel.”
Jehu said, “Jezebel practices idolatry.”
Jehu said, “Jezebel practices witchcraft.”
Jehu said, “There are many acts of idolatry and witchcraft.”
Jehu said, “As long as these acts continue, there cannot be peace.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּרְא֤וֹת יְהוֹרָם֙ אֶת־ יֵה֔וּא וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הֲשָׁל֣וֹם יֵה֑וּא וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ מָ֣ה הַשָּׁל֔וֹם עַד־ זְנוּנֵ֞י אִיזֶ֧בֶל אִמְּךָ֛ וּכְשָׁפֶ֖יהָ הָרַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: Joram turned around and fled, calling out to Ahaziah, “Treachery, Ahaziah!”
passages.sermon:
Joram was the king of Israel.
Joram saw Jehu.
Joram realized there was danger.
Joram turned his chariot around.
Joram tried to escape.
Joram shouted to Ahaziah.
Ahaziah was the king of Judah.
Joram called out, “Treachery, Ahaziah!”
passages.original: וַיַּהֲפֹ֧ךְ יְהוֹרָ֛ם יָדָ֖יו וַיָּנֹ֑ס וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ אֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ מִרְמָ֥ה אֲחַזְיָֽה׃

passages.text: Then Jehu drew his bow and shot Joram between the shoulders. The arrow pierced his heart, and he slumped down in his chariot.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander chosen by God to punish the house of Ahab.
Jehu took his bow in his hand.
Jehu aimed at King Joram.
Jehu shot Joram between the shoulders.
The arrow went through Joram’s heart.
Joram slumped down in his chariot.
passages.original: וְיֵה֞וּא מִלֵּ֧א יָד֣וֹ בַקֶּ֗שֶׁת וַיַּ֤ךְ אֶת־ יְהוֹרָם֙ בֵּ֣ין זְרֹעָ֔יו וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַחֵ֖צִי מִלִּבּ֑וֹ וַיִּכְרַ֖ע בְּרִכְבּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And Jehu said to Bidkar his officer, “Pick him up and throw him into the field of Naboth the Jezreelite. For remember that when you and I were riding together behind his father Ahab, the LORD lifted up this burden against him: ‘As surely as I saw the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons yesterday, declares the LORD, so will I repay you on this plot of ground, declares the LORD.’ Now then, according to the word of the LORD, pick him up and throw him on the plot of ground.”
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander in Israel.
Jehu spoke to Bidkar, his officer.
Jehu said, “Pick up Joram’s body.
Throw him into the field of Naboth the Jezreelite.
Remember, you and I rode together behind Ahab, Joram’s father.
At that time, the LORD gave this message about Ahab.
The LORD said, ‘I saw the blood of Naboth and his sons yesterday.
I will repay you on this very plot of ground.’
This is what the LORD declared.
Now, pick up Joram’s body.
Throw him on the field, as the LORD has said.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֶל־ בִּדְקַר֙ שְׁלֹשָׁה שָׂ֚א הַשְׁלִכֵ֔הוּ בְּחֶלְקַ֕ת שְׂדֵ֖ה נָב֣וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֑י כִּֽי־ זְכֹ֞ר אֲנִ֣י וָאַ֗תָּה אֵ֣ת רֹכְבִ֤ים צְמָדִים֙ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אַחְאָ֣ב אָבִ֔יו וַֽיהוָה֙ נָשָׂ֣א עָלָ֔יו אֶת־ הַמַּשָּׂ֖א הַזֶּֽה׃ אִם־ לֹ֡א אֶת־ דְּמֵ֣י נָבוֹת֩ וְאֶת־ דְּמֵ֨י בָנָ֜יו רָאִ֤יתִי אֶ֙מֶשׁ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֥י לְךָ֛ בַּחֶלְקָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְעַתָּ֗ה שָׂ֧א הַשְׁלִכֵ֛הוּ בַּחֶלְקָ֖ה כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: When King Ahaziah of Judah saw this, he fled up the road toward Beth-haggan. And Jehu pursued him, shouting, “Shoot him too!” So they shot Ahaziah in his chariot on the Ascent of Gur, near Ibleam, and he fled to Megiddo and died there.
passages.sermon:
King Ahaziah ruled over Judah.
Ahaziah saw what happened.
He fled up the road toward Beth-haggan.
Jehu saw Ahaziah fleeing.
Jehu pursued Ahaziah.
Jehu shouted, “Shoot him too!”
Jehu’s men shot Ahaziah while he was in his chariot.
They shot him on the Ascent of Gur, near Ibleam.
Ahaziah fled to Megiddo.
Ahaziah died in Megiddo.
passages.original: וַאֲחַזְיָ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֙ רָאָ֔ה וַיָּ֕נָס דֶּ֖רֶךְ בֵּ֣ית הַגָּ֑ן וַיִּרְדֹּ֨ף אַחֲרָ֜יו יֵה֗וּא וַ֠יֹּאמֶר גַּם־ אֹת֞וֹ הַכֻּ֣הוּ אֶל־ הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֗ה בְּמַֽעֲלֵה־ גוּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶֽת־ יִבְלְעָ֔ם וַיָּ֥נָס מְגִדּ֖וֹ וַיָּ֥מָת שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Then his servants carried him by chariot to Jerusalem and buried him with his fathers in his tomb in the City of David.
passages.sermon:
Ahaziah was the king of Judah.
His servants took his body.
They placed his body in a chariot.
They brought him to Jerusalem.
They buried him in his own tomb.
They buried him with his fathers.
They buried him in the City of David.
passages.original: וַיַּרְכִּ֧בוּ אֹת֛וֹ עֲבָדָ֖יו יְרוּשָׁלְָ֑מָה וַיִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֹת֧וֹ בִקְבֻרָת֛וֹ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֥יר דָּוִֽד׃פ

passages.text: (In the eleventh year of Joram son of Ahab, Ahaziah had become king over Judah.)
passages.sermon:
Ahaziah became king over Judah.
Joram was the son of Ahab.
Ahaziah became king in the eleventh year of Joram’s reign.
passages.original: וּבִשְׁנַת֙ אַחַ֣ת עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְיוֹרָ֖ם בֶּן־ אַחְאָ֑ב מָלַ֥ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֖ה עַל־ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: Now when Jehu arrived in Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it. So she painted her eyes, adorned her head, and looked down from a window.
passages.sermon:
Jehu arrived in Jezreel.
Jezebel heard that Jehu had come.
Jezebel painted her eyes.
Jezebel adorned her head.
Jezebel looked down from a window.
passages.original: וַיָּב֥וֹא יֵה֖וּא יִזְרְעֶ֑אלָה וְאִיזֶ֣בֶל שָׁמְעָ֗ה וַתָּ֨שֶׂם בַּפּ֤וּךְ עֵינֶ֙יהָ֙ וַתֵּ֣יטֶב אֶת־ רֹאשָׁ֔הּ וַתַּשְׁקֵ֖ף בְּעַ֥ד הַחַלּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: And as Jehu entered the gate, she asked, “Have you come in peace, O Zimri, murderer of your master?”
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander in Israel.
Jehu entered the gate of Jezreel.
Jezebel was the queen in Jezreel.
Jezebel saw Jehu enter the gate.
Jezebel spoke to Jehu.
Jezebel asked Jehu, “Have you come in peace?”
Jezebel called Jehu “Zimri.”
Jezebel called Jehu “murderer of your master.”
passages.original: וְיֵה֖וּא בָּ֣א בַשָּׁ֑עַר וַתֹּ֣אמֶר הֲשָׁל֔וֹם זִמְרִ֖י הֹרֵ֥ג אֲדֹנָֽיו׃

passages.text: He looked up at the window and called out, “Who is on my side? Who?” And two or three eunuchs looked down at him.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander who had just arrived in Jezreel.
He looked up at the window.
He called out loudly.
He said, “Who is on my side? Who?”
Two or three eunuchs heard him.
They looked down at Jehu from the window.
passages.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֤א פָנָיו֙ אֶל־ הַ֣חַלּ֔וֹן וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֥י אִתִּ֖י מִ֑י וַיַּשְׁקִ֣יפוּ אֵלָ֔יו שְׁנַ֥יִם שְׁלֹשָׁ֖ה סָרִיסִֽים׃

passages.text: “Throw her down!” yelled Jehu. So they threw her down, and her blood splattered on the wall and on the horses as they trampled her underfoot.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander chosen by God to destroy the house of Ahab.
Jehu shouted, “Throw her down!”
The eunuchs threw Jezebel down from the window.
Her blood splattered on the wall.
Her blood splattered on the horses.
The horses trampled Jezebel under their feet.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר שִׁמְטֻהוּ וַֽיִּשְׁמְט֑וּהָ וַיִּ֨ז מִדָּמָ֧הּ אֶל־ הַקִּ֛יר וְאֶל־ הַסּוּסִ֖ים וַֽיִּרְמְסֶֽנָּה׃

passages.text: Then Jehu went in and ate and drank. “Take care of this cursed woman,” he said, “and bury her, for she was the daughter of a king.”
passages.sermon:
Jehu was a commander chosen by God to destroy the house of Ahab.
Jehu went into the house.
Jehu ate.
Jehu drank.
Jehu said, “Take care of this cursed woman.”
Jehu said, “Bury her.”
Jehu said, “She was the daughter of a king.”
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֖א וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיֵּ֑שְׁתְּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פִּקְדוּ־ נָ֞א אֶת־ הָאֲרוּרָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ וְקִבְר֔וּהָ כִּ֥י בַת־ מֶ֖לֶךְ הִֽיא׃

passages.text: But when they went out to bury her, they found nothing but her skull, her feet, and the palms of her hands.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the king of Israel.
Jehu ordered his men to bury Jezebel.
Jezebel was the daughter of a king.
The men went out to bury Jezebel.
They did not find her whole body.
They found only her skull.
They found only her feet.
They found only the palms of her hands.
passages.original: וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ לְקָבְרָ֑הּ וְלֹא־ מָ֣צְאוּ בָ֗הּ כִּ֧י אִם־ הַגֻּלְגֹּ֛לֶת וְהָרַגְלַ֖יִם וְכַפּ֥וֹת הַיָּדָֽיִם׃

passages.text: So they went back and told Jehu, who replied, “This is the word of the LORD, which He spoke through His servant Elijah the Tishbite: ‘On the plot of ground at Jezreel the dogs will devour the flesh of Jezebel.
passages.sermon:
Jehu was the king of Israel.
Some men went back to Jehu.
They told Jehu what they had found.
Jehu spoke to them.
Jehu said, “This is the word of the LORD.
The LORD spoke this word through His servant Elijah the Tishbite.
The LORD said, ‘On the land at Jezreel, dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel.’”
passages.original: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ֮ וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ לוֹ֒ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֣ה ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֗ר בְּיַד־ עַבְדּ֛וֹ אֵלִיָּ֥הוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר בְּחֵ֣לֶק יִזְרְעֶ֔אל יֹאכְל֥וּ הַכְּלָבִ֖ים אֶת־ בְּשַׂ֥ר אִיזָֽבֶל׃

passages.text: And Jezebel’s body will lie like dung in the field on the plot of ground at Jezreel, so that no one can say: This is Jezebel.’”
passages.sermon:
Jezebel was a queen in Israel.
\r\nShe was the wife of King Ahab.
\r\nGod judged Jezebel for her evil deeds.
\r\nJezebel’s body will lie like dung in the field.
\r\nThis will happen on the plot of ground at Jezreel.
\r\nNo one will be able to say, “This is Jezebel.”
passages.original: וְהָיָת נִבְלַ֣ת אִיזֶ֗בֶל כְּדֹ֛מֶן עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה בְּחֵ֣לֶק יִזְרְעֶ֑אל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יֹאמְר֖וּ זֹ֥את אִיזָֽבֶל׃פ
